::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Synopsys India is one of the company's largest R&D centres globally. India teams develop core EDA tools used by every major chipmaker worldwide, plus DesignWare IP.
:::

## What does this firm design?

EDA tools (synthesis, place-and-route, simulation, verification), DesignWare IP cores (USB, PCIe, DDR, Ethernet), and silicon lifecycle management solutions.
